name: FileBrowser Quantum v2
description: FileBrowser Quantum 2.0 file manager. This is a new app, separate from FileBrowser Quantum 1.5.8. v2 stores users and shares in SQLite and refuses to start while a v1 database.db file is still in the data directory. Do not attach the 1.5.8 data volume. A fresh install prints a one-time admin password in the container logs.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  big-bear-filebrowser-quantum-v2:
    container_name: big-bear-filebrowser-quantum-v2
    image: gtstef/filebrowser:2.0.2-stable@sha256:de2b4c4d18485ea202ab2cdada5bd25d8f0b8ed071712c8216a67194c31285ae
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TZ=UTC
      - FILEBROWSER_DATABASE_PATH=/home/filebrowser/data/database.sqlite
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/home/filebrowser/data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/srv:/srv
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    networks:
      - big-bear-filebrowser-quantum-v2-network
networks:
  big-bear-filebrowser-quantum-v2-network:
    driver: bridge
